name: Croakley
bio: Ran the bait shop by the pond until somebody shot it up. Now he returns the favour, suspenders and all.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB, rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not Boglurker (a different toad, in rags): a cartoon frog in a vest, jeans and suspenders. Rebuilt 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b) from the re-rigged download "T Pose Frog in Suspenders" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used).
